summary: Prebuilt darwin/x64 binary bundles WebSocket client with PTY spawning and hardcoded remote endpoints
details: The package ships a single prebuilt Mach-O binary at bin/ccfly-setup (~7 MB) that links github.com/creack/pty (PTY spawning) together with github.com/gorilla/websocket (WebSocket client) and embeds hardcoded remote endpoints ws://ccflycc.hn, wss://<host>, and https://cc.hn. The WebSocket + PTY combination implements a remote-controlled shell: bytes received from the hardcoded server are fed to a locally spawned PTY, giving the operator of that endpoint interactive command execution on the host once the binary runs. Embedded Chinese status string '客户端已安装并配对' ("client installed and paired") is consistent with a pairing/command-and-control workflow. The package.json in this sub-package declares no scripts, main, or bin field, so npm install of this tarball alone does not execute the binary; the binary is staged into node_modules and is intended to be launched by a sibling @ccfly/* wrapper package or by the user, at which point full-host code execution reaches an author-controlled remote endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
